name: skill-factory-experiments
description: Three domain-expert Claude Code skills (real-estate auction risk analysis, SEO longtail keyword strategy, e-commerce listing optimization) built to test whether a 'knowledge -> SKILL.md' pipeline generalizes across unrelated domains.

plugins.name: real-estate-auction-analysis
plugins.description: Analyzes Korean court real-estate auction listings for encumbrances the winning bidder would inherit (senior liens, tenants with priority). Reference checklist, not legal advice.

plugins.name: seo-longtail-keyword-strategy
plugins.description: Judges whether a keyword is winnable for a small/new site before you write the post, using search-intent and competitor-type signals instead of gut feel.

plugins.name: smartstore-listing-optimization
plugins.description: Reviews an e-commerce product listing (title, image, detail page, price) for exposure vs. conversion problems, and flags deceptive-advertising risk (undisclosed paid reviews, guaranteed-effect claims).
